closes_when: In e.png 2-6 the right-edge figure stays partly visible and slides out of frame through frame 6 as in f.png, and the left-edge fragment is drawn as the head/neck of the bird coming in rather than a lone body arc, with the leg growing in over frames 5-7 instead of appearing at once in frame 6.
protect: The tucked-head, one-leg standing pose built from the doodle's own parts (round head with beak dash, oval body, triangle leg joint, single long leg); the left-centre placement and long still hold from frame 9 onward that matches the film; the timing of the entry at frames 5-8; the sparse line style without added detail.
